messages.content: 有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？

function.name: movies_search

message.content: 截至目前（2023年底/2024年初）的統計，全球票房最高的電影是 **《阿凡達》**（Avatar，2009 年上映）。根據 Box Office Mojo 等公開資料，其全球總票房已突破 28 億美元（約 280 億人民幣左右），保持了超過十年的領先地位。第二名則是《復仇者聯盟：終局之戰》（Avengers: Endgame，2019 年），其全球票房約為 27 億美元。
message.reasoning:
The user asks: "有史以來最高票房的電影是什麼？" which means "What is the highest-grossing movie ever?" They want the highest grossing film worldwide. That would be "Avatar" (2009) or "Avengers: Endgame"? As of 2023, "Avatar" remains top with $2.92B worldwide. But we need to confirm. We can use the movies_search function? It expects title and year. But we don't know the title. We could search for "highest grossing movie". But the function only searches by title and year. So maybe we can't get it via function. We might answer directly: "截至目前（2023年），全球票房最高的是《阿凡達》（2009）" etc. But we should check if there's updated info. In 2024, "Avatar" still holds record. So answer accordingly.

We can also mention that "Avengers: Endgame" was second. Provide numbers. Use Chinese.
